name: indulgence
description: Convenience scripts from the repo root. Each package (gate/, web/, demo/) has its own package.json and node_modules. The package itself (main, exports, files) is only the OpenCode plugin in opencode-plugin/, so that `opencode plugin github:lukekh/indulgence` can install it.

scripts.install:all: npm --prefix gate install && npm --prefix web install && npm --prefix demo install
scripts.sync:prayer-log: for d in codex-plugin/scripts antigravity-plugin/scripts opencode-plugin; do cp plugin/scripts/prayer-log.mjs "$d/"; done
scripts.test: npm --prefix gate test && npm --prefix web test && node --test opencode-plugin/index.test.js
